summary.text: Clay Faircloth is an independent candidate for Tennessee's 4th District. Ballotpedia lists his profession as pastor and social worker, and in a 2024 Candidate Connection survey he described himself as a counselor, pastor and community engagement influencer; he previously sought the Democratic nomination in the 6th District in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from McGavock High School and earned a graduate degree from Trevecca Nazarene University in 2013.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as pastor, work at a Nissan plant, and career coaching with Metro Nashville; it lists his profession as pastor and social worker.
In his 2024 Ballotpedia survey, describes himself as a counselor, pastor and community engagement influencer.

Appeared on the Democratic primary ballot for Tennessee's 6th District in 2022 and 2024, losing to Randal Cooper and Lore Bergman respectively; he is running as an independent in the 4th District in 2026.
